blocks.text: Machine learning, data science ka ek hissa (subfield) hai jo systems ko tajurbe (experience) se behtar hone deta hai, baghair is ke ke har kaam ke liye alag se program likha jaye. Is mein data ke patterns parakh kar predictions (andaze) ya faisle kiye jate hain. Models ko train karne (sikhane) ke liye bare datasets istemal hote hain; jab naya data aata hai to model waqt ke saath dhalte aur behtar hote jate hain. Yeh technique aaj ki bohat si applications mein istemal hoti hai aur automation (khud-kaar kaam) aur intelligent (zaheen) systems ko chalati hai.

Pehle se tay rules (qawaid) ki bajaye machine learning system ko examples (misalon) se seekhne deti hai; system patterns pehchanta hai aur un se andaze lagata hai. Jitna zyada data system process karta hai, utna zyada accurate aur efficient hota jata hai. Is se smart applications chalti hain aur haath ka kaam kam hota hai.

blocks.title: Machine learning kahan aati hai
blocks.text: Yahan kitab machine learning ko data science ka hissa kehti hai, aur chapter ki Summary ise artificial intelligence ki shaakh (branch) kehti hai. Dono baatein aam taur par kahi jati hain: machine learning artificial intelligence ka hissa hai, aur data science ke bunyadi tools mein se bhi ek hai.

Data se seekhne ka matlab hai purani maloomat se faisle behtar karna. Is amal mein data ek learning model ko input ke taur par diya jata hai, aur model data ke andar ke rishte (relationships) parakhta hai. Baar baar training se ghaltiyan kam hoti hain aur nataij zyada durust hote jate hain. Yeh seekhna kabhi khatam nahi hota, kyunke naya data milne par model update hota hai. Is tarah system waqt ke saath zyada smart hota jata hai.
Difference Between Traditional Programming and Machine Learning (farq)

Traditional (riwayati, purani tarz ki) programming mein programmer fixed rules (muqarrar qawaid) likhta hai, aur program in rules par chal kar output deta hai. Machine learning mein fixed rules ki jagah data istemal hota hai: system data se rules khud seekhta hai. Traditional programming mein kuch badalna ho to naya code likhna parta hai; machine learning mein tabdeeli naye data se aati hai. Is liye machine learning complex (pecheeda) masle behtar sambhalti hai aur nayi suraton mein dhal jati hai. Figure 6.3 dono ka farq dikhati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen panel, riwayati programming: data aur programmer ke likhe qawaid program mein jate jo output deta; naye bartao ke liye naya code. Daen panel, machine learning: data aur maloom outputs (misalein) learning mein jate jo model (dhoonde gaye qawaid) banati; naya bartao naye data se.

blocks.long_description: Spam filter farq dikhata hai: programmer har spam chaal ko qaide ki tarah nahi likh sakta, lekin hazaron labelled emails par train hua model naqsh khud dhoond leta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek program F = 1.8C + 32 se Celsius ko Fahrenheit mein badalta hai. Yeh traditional programming hai ya machine learning? Machine learning yahi rule kaise seekh sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh traditional programming hai: rule programmer ne khud likha. Machine learning model ko Celsius aur Fahrenheit ke bohat se jore diye jayein to linear regression se woh taqreeban 1.8 ka slope (dhalaan) aur taqreeban 32 ka intercept khud seekh leta hai.

items: Machine learning: system haath ke likhe rules ki bajaye data se patterns seekhta hai.
Model training aur naye data se behtar hota rehta hai.
Traditional: rules + data se output; machine learning: data (aur misalon) se rules (model).
